source_description_html:
Bagster is one of the world's leading manufacturers for after market motorcycle seats. These seats are a huge improvement in comfort and style and can be configured in an almost endless amount of combinations in regards to colors and materials. To make things easy for you, we stock the most popular seats in the best looking configurations available! If you're after a seat, custom-built and tailored to your liking, please contact us by phone or e-mail as we can help you out with that as well!

We stock Bagster Ready seats and Bagster Ready Luxe seats. The difference is that Ready seats always use standard Bagster seating foam and allow limited customization: only the color of the piping and stitching and the embroidery can be adjusted.
The Ready Luxe seats can be customized almost without limitations as every panel can be a different color or material if you so wish. Apart from that, you can equip the seat with Bultex foam, which is a higher grade foam offering outstanding comfort for longer rides.

There are only a couple of things to keep in mind:

Making sure the seat will fit your bike: Please carefully check the product title of this seat for your bike's brand, model and year. As a double check, take a look at the picture we took of this seat and compare it to the seat of your bike.

Selecting your favorite color and materials: The seats we have in stock usually have a neutral color for the piping and stitching like black or silver. In other cases, these details may have a color similar to the paintwork of the bike the seat is suitable for. For example a fluorescent yellow to match the yellow wheels of a Yamaha MT-07. Or the vibrant green you will find on many Kawasakis. Apart from the color, you have to consider the materials of the various panels. We try to describe the materials in the product titles as best as we can, but please look at the product image carefully to see what it really looks like.

Bultex foam, yes or no? Most of the Ready Luxe seats we have in stock are equipped with Bultex foam, but there are a few exceptions. Please check the product title carefully. In the Additional Information tab on the product page, we also mention if a seat does or does not have Bultex foam.

As a general rule: feel free to contact us if you have any questions about a particular seat or if you are looking for a Bagster seat we do not have in stock right now. We're here to help you take your bike's comfort levels to the next level!

We stock Bagster Ready seats and Bagster Ready Luxe seats. The difference is that Ready seats always use standard Bagster seating foam and allow limited customization: only the color of the piping and stitching and the embroidery can be adjusted.
The Ready Luxe seats can be customized almost without limitations as every panel can be a different color or material if you so wish. Apart from that, you can equip the seat with Bultex foam, which is a higher grade foam offering outstanding comfort for longer rides.

There are only a couple of things to keep in mind:

Making sure the seat will fit your bike: Please carefully check the product title of this seat for your bike's brand, model and year. As a double check, take a look at the picture we took of this seat and compare it to the seat of your bike.

Selecting your favorite color and materials: The seats we have in stock usually have a neutral color for the piping and stitching like black or silver. In other cases, these details may have a color similar to the paintwork of the bike the seat is suitable for. For example a fluorescent yellow to match the yellow wheels of a Yamaha MT-07. Or the vibrant green you will find on many Kawasakis. Apart from the color, you have to consider the materials of the various panels. We try to describe the materials in the product titles as best as we can, but please look at the product image carefully to see what it really looks like.

Bultex foam, yes or no? Most of the Ready Luxe seats we have in stock are equipped with Bultex foam, but there are a few exceptions. Please check the product title carefully. In the Additional Information tab on the product page, we also mention if a seat does or does not have Bultex foam.

As a general rule: feel free to contact us if you have any questions about a particular seat or if you are looking for a Bagster seat we do not have in stock right now. We're here to help you take your bike's comfort levels to the next level!
